name: qq-bridge-worker
description: Connects an Antigravity worker agent to the local qq-bridge AGY transport queue (default persona: 猫娘侍从): inspect per-persona routing, wait/claim QQ turns, read verbatim/spilled wake prompts, and return structured replies.
suggestedPrompts: 检查 D:\dsh\qq-bridge 的 AGY 传输层状态（dutyTransport 与 personaTransport）
启动猫娘侍从 QQ 值守 worker，按 qq-bot-operator 流程开始轮询并回复
查看 state/agy-worker.log 与 state/bridge.log 中的 [agy] 记录
